content.text:
I removed the footer line and moved the model count into the Artificial Analysis box. All changes are in [site/index.html](site/index.html).

- **Footer line:** The "Menu updated … · models scored · data as of:" paragraph is gone, along with its JS and its unused `.updated` CSS. This also drops the "Menu updated" date, since it was part of that line.
- **Artificial Analysis box:** It now shows "N models scored" as a note, next to the Intelligence Index version.
- **Checks:** I only edited the HTML, so I ran `npm run format`, which changed nothing. I skipped typecheck and lint because no `.ts` files changed.

I didn't load the page in the browser to check how the box looks.
